summary: SMART-TC iteration 4 — Line/Area migration fix + Master Reset. Backend 17/17 pytest pass: strict validate_line_area rejects ASSEMBLING/FI/FINAL INSPECTION (422), accepts 'ASSEMBLING & FI' on POST/PUT /master-parts and /master-parts/import/preview. GET /master-parts-admin/invalid-lines returns {count: 1209, samples[], valid_lines}. DELETE /master-parts-admin/reset-all returns 403 for non-creator and 401/403 unauthenticated (NOT executed as Creator — would wipe 1209 legacy rows). normalize_line no longer silently migrates: GET /master-parts?line=ASSEMBLING returns only legacy rows. Frontend (Creator + Non-creator) all features verified: migration banner with count/samples/reset-link, Reset button (creator-only), ResetDialog disabled/enabled state on 'RESET' input, Edit dialog preserves invalid line + inline warning, Dashboard Total Part card hidden on 'Semua' + visible on specific line (ASSEMBLING & FI → 1213), sidebar shows 'IN / OUT History' (no 'Data Sparepart'), Form Request uses 'ke atasan'. Non-creator does NOT see reset button.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> dynamic-attribute child inside <option> (caused by dev tooling, harmless but should be cleaned up before prod). Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby — minor a11y nit.

critical_code_review_comments: validate_line_area is consistently called on POST /master-parts, PUT /master-parts/{mid}, /master-parts/import/preview, and /master-parts/import/save — coverage is complete.
Reset endpoint placement at /master-parts-admin/* correctly avoids collision with /master-parts/{mid} dynamic route — good routing design.
/master-parts-admin/invalid-lines uses $nin against VALID_LINE_AREAS and excludes _id — correct.

normalize_line() retains only .upper().strip() (no silent migrate) — matches review-spec; verified empirically that filter line=ASSEMBLING returns only legacy ASSEMBLING rows, not ASSEMBLING & FI rows.
server.py still 1426 lines — refactor into modules is overdue.
Dashboard Total Part card uses /api/stock/summary?line= and works correctly for specific line; properly hidden when filter=Semua.
